Satya Nadella, chairman and chief executive officer, Amy Hood, executive vice president and chief financial officer, Alice Jolla, chief accounting officer, Brian DeFoe, deputy general counsel and corporate secretary, and Jonathan Neilson, vice president of investor relations, will host a conference call and webcast at 2:30 p.m. Pacific time (5:30 p.m. Eastern time) today to discuss details of the company’s performance for the quarter and certain forward-looking information.
Participants can also dial into the conference call at (877) 407-0666 or +1 (201) 689-8023 for international, no password required.
The webcast will be available for replay through the close of business on October 28, 2027.

In the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, net income and diluted earnings per share were impacted by net gains from investments in OpenAI, which resulted in an increase in net income and diluted earnings per share of $207 million and $0.03, respectively.

In the first quarter of fiscal year 2026, net income and diluted earnings per share were impacted by net losses from investments in OpenAI, which resulted in a decrease in net income and diluted earnings per share of $3.1 billion and $0.41, respectively.

We have recast certain prior period amounts to conform to the way we internally manage and monitor our business, which reflects the fiscal year 2027 changes to our segments announced in September 2026.
